title: Transferable Visit Balance on a Self-Pay Visit Package
content:
**Patient Services calculation memo — Self-Pay Visit Package transfers.** Before the transferable balance is worked out, every installment of the giving package whose due date has passed must stand paid in the package's history.

**Standing visits.** The visits standing on the giving package are the visits credited to it less the visits used, forfeited, expired, transferred and refunded, as the package history shows them.

**Visits that move.** Every visit standing on the giving package moves and nothing is kept back; the count of visits that move never goes below zero.

**The ledger read from the package history**

| Entries that add visits | Entries that remove visits |
|---|---|
| visit credits on installment payments or payment in full | visits used at attended appointments |
| visit credits for visits received by transfer | visits forfeited |
| visit credits restoring a forfeited visit | visits removed at expiry |
| visit credits on reinstatement | visits transferred out |
| | visits removed on a refund |

**Worked count (hypothetical history)**

| Entry | Visits |
|---|---|
| Credit on installment 1 | 6 |
| Credit on installment 2 | 6 |
| Visits used at attended appointments | 5 |
| Visit forfeited | 1 |
| Standing visits: 12 credited less 6 removed | 6 |
| Visits that move | 6 |
